name: Bowed
author: Emilie Gillet
description: A bowed string waveguide with a stick-slip friction exciter, a movable bow and an adjustable instrument body.

controls.label: Bow position
controls.description: Moves the bow from near the bridge to well up the neck.

controls.label: Bow pressure
controls.description: Increases bow pressure from a thin whistle to a hard scrape.

controls.label: Nut damping
controls.description: Opens the nut damping from tight and choked to loose and ringing.

controls.label: Body
controls.description: Tilts the instrument body darker or brighter around the stock resonance.

outputs.main: The bridge pickup through the instrument body.
outputs.aux: The neck pickup through the same body filter.
